speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.

speaker: god
text: If one’s offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to present an unblemished male. He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

speaker: god
text: And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to present the blood and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

speaker: god
text: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

speaker: god
text: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.

speaker: god
text: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall burn all of it on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: If, however, one’s offering is a burnt offering from the flock—from the sheep or goats—he is to present an unblemished male.

speaker: god
text: He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

speaker: god
text: He is to cut the animal into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and fat, atop the burning wood that is on the altar.

speaker: god
text: The entrails and legs must be washed with water, and the priest shall bring all of it and burn it on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: If, instead, one’s offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to present a turtledove or a young pigeon.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest shall bring it to the altar, twist off its head, and burn it on the altar; its blood should be drained out on the side of the altar.

speaker: god
text: And he is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, in the place for ashes.

speaker: god
text: He shall tear it open by its wings, without dividing the bird completely. And the priest is to burn it on the altar atop the burning wood. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: When anyone brings a grain offering to the LORD, his offering must consist of fine flour. He is to pour olive oil on it, put frankincense on it,

speaker: god
text: and bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the frankincense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: The remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Now if you bring an offering of grain baked in an oven, it must consist of fine flour, either unleavened cakes mixed with oil or unleavened wafers coated with oil.

speaker: god
text: If your offering is a grain offering prepared on a griddle, it must be unleavened bread made of fine flour mixed with oil.

speaker: god
text: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

speaker: god
text: If your offering is a grain offering cooked in a pan, it must consist of fine flour with oil.

speaker: god
text: When you bring to the LORD the grain offering made in any of these ways, it is to be presented to the priest, and he shall take it to the altar.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to remove the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: But the remainder of the grain offering shall belong to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made by fire to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: No grain offering that you present to the LORD may be made with leaven, for you are not to burn any leaven or honey as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

speaker: god
text: And you shall season each of your grain offerings with salt. You must not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offering; you are to add salt to each of your offerings.

speaker: god
text: If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, you shall offer crushed heads of new grain roasted on the fire.

speaker: god
text: And you are to put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

speaker: god
text: The priest shall then burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all its frankincense, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: If one’s offering is a peace offering and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he must present it without blemish before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.

speaker: god
text: From the peace offering he is to bring an offering made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,

speaker: god
text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.

speaker: god
text: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar atop the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: If, however, one’s peace offering to the LORD is from the flock, he must present a male or female without blemish.

speaker: god
text: If he is presenting a lamb for his offering, he must present it before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

speaker: god
text: And from the peace offering he shall bring an offering made by fire to the LORD consisting of its fat: the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,

speaker: god
text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: If one’s offering is a goat, he is to present it before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: He must lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

speaker: god
text: And from his offering he shall present an offering made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,

speaker: god
text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to burn the food on the altar as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the LORD’s.

speaker: god
text: This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Tell the Israelites to do as follows with one who sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s commandments and does what is forbidden by them:

speaker: god
text: If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

speaker: god
text: He must bring the bull to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, lay his hand on the bull’s head, and slaughter it before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the veil of the sanctuary.

speaker: god
text: The priest must then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. And he is to pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,

speaker: god
text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys—

speaker: god
text: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

speaker: god
text: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, with its head and legs and its entrails and dung—

speaker: god
text: all the rest of the bull—he must take outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place where the ashes are poured out, and there he must burn it on a wood fire on the ash heap.

speaker: god
text: Now if the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly so that they violate any of the LORD’s commandments and incur guilt by doing what is forbidden,

speaker: god
text: when they become aware of the sin they have committed, then the assembly must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD, and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting,

speaker: god
text: and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD in front of the veil.

speaker: god
text: He is also to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting, and he must pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: And he is to remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar.

speaker: god
text: He shall offer this bull just as he did the bull for the sin offering; in this way the priest will make atonement on their behalf, and they will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: Then he is to take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

speaker: god
text: When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the commandments of the LORD his God, he incurs guilt.

speaker: god
text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished male goat as his offering.

speaker: god
text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

speaker: god
text: He must burn all its fat on the altar, like the fat of the peace offerings; thus the priest will make atonement for that man’s sin, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: And if one of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the LORD’s commandments, he incurs guilt.

speaker: god
text: When he becomes aware of the sin he has committed, he must bring an unblemished female goat as his offering for that sin.

speaker: god
text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to take some of its blood with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

speaker: god
text: Then he is to remove all the fat, just as it is removed from the peace offering, and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: If, however, he brings a lamb as a sin offering, he must bring an unblemished female.

speaker: god
text: And he is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

speaker: god
text: And he shall remove all the fat, just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the peace offerings, and he shall burn it on the altar along with the offerings made by fire to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: If someone sins by failing to testify when he hears a public charge about something he has witnessed, whether he has seen it or learned of it, he shall bear the iniquity.

speaker: god
text: Or if a person touches anything unclean—whether the carcass of any unclean wild animal or livestock or crawling creature—even if he is unaware of it, he is unclean and guilty.

speaker: god
text: Or if he touches human uncleanness—anything by which one becomes unclean—even if he is unaware of it, when he realizes it, he is guilty.

speaker: god
text: Or if someone swears thoughtlessly with his lips to do anything good or evil—in whatever matter a man may rashly pronounce an oath—even if he is unaware of it, when he realizes it, he is guilty in the matter.

speaker: god
text: If someone incurs guilt in one of these ways, he must confess the sin he has committed,

speaker: god
text: and he must bring his guilt offering to the LORD for the sin he has committed: a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering. And the priest will make atonement for him concerning his sin.

speaker: god
text: If, however, he cannot afford a lamb, he may bring to the LORD as restitution for his sin two turtledoves or two young pigeons—one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering.

speaker: god
text: He is to bring them to the priest, who shall first present the one for the sin offering. He is to twist its head at the front of its neck without severing it;

speaker: god
text: then he is to sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar, while the rest of the blood is drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: And the priest must prepare the second bird as a burnt offering according to the ordinance. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he may bring a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He must not put olive oil or frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: He is to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful from it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar atop the offerings made by fire to the LORD; it is a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: In this way the priest will make atonement for him for any of these sins he has committed, and he will be forgiven. The remainder will belong to the priest, like the grain offering.

speaker: god
text: If someone acts unfaithfully and sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s holy things, he must bring his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram from the flock, of proper value in silver shekels according to the sanctuary shekel; it is a guilt offering.

speaker: god
text: Regarding any holy thing he has harmed, he must make restitution by adding a fifth of its value to it and giving it to the priest, who will make atonement on his behalf with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: If someone sins and violates any of the LORD’s commandments even though he was unaware, he is guilty and shall bear his punishment.

speaker: god
text: He is to bring to the priest an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock as a guilt offering. Then the priest will make atonement on his behalf for the wrong he has committed in ignorance, and he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: It is a guilt offering; he was certainly guilty before the LORD.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: If someone sins and acts unfaithfully against the LORD by deceiving his neighbor in regard to a deposit or security entrusted to him or stolen, or if he extorts his neighbor

speaker: god
text: or finds lost property and lies about it and swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that a man might commit—

speaker: god
text: once he has sinned and becomes guilty, he must return what he has stolen or taken by extortion, or the deposit entrusted to him, or the lost property he found,

speaker: god
text: or anything else about which he has sworn falsely. He must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value, and pay it to the owner on the day he acknowledges his guilt.

speaker: god
text: Then he must bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD: an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock.

speaker: god
text: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for anything he may have done to incur guilt.

speaker: god
text: Command Aaron and his sons that this is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the hearth of the altar all night, until morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

speaker: god
text: And the priest shall put on his linen robe and linen undergarments, and he shall remove from the altar the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed and place them beside it.

speaker: god
text: Then he must take off his garments, put on other clothes, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a ceremonially clean place.

speaker: god
text: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning; it must not be extinguished. Every morning the priest is to add wood to the fire, arrange the burnt offering on it, and burn the fat portions of the peace offerings on it.

speaker: god
text: The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it must not be extinguished.

speaker: god
text: Now this is the law of the grain offering: Aaron’s sons shall present it before the LORD in front of the altar.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to remove a handful of fine flour and olive oil, together with all the frankincense from the grain offering, and burn the memorial portion on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Aaron and his sons are to eat the remainder. It must be eaten without leaven in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: It must not be baked with leaven; I have assigned it as their portion of My offerings made by fire. It is most holy, like the sin offering and the guilt offering.

speaker: god
text: Any male among the sons of Aaron may eat it. This is a permanent portion from the offerings made by fire to the LORD for the generations to come. Anything that touches them will become holy.

speaker: god
text: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons must present to the LORD on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

speaker: god
text: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle; you are to bring it well-kneaded and present it as a grain offering broken in pieces, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: The priest, who is one of Aaron’s sons and will be anointed to take his place, is to prepare it. As a permanent portion for the LORD, it must be burned completely.

speaker: god
text: Every grain offering for a priest shall be burned completely; it is not to be eaten.

speaker: god
text: Tell Aaron and his sons that this is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD; it is most holy.

speaker: god
text: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it must be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Anything that touches its flesh will become holy, and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment, you must wash it in a holy place.

speaker: god
text: The clay pot in which the sin offering is boiled must be broken; if it is boiled in a bronze pot, the pot must be scoured and rinsed with water.

speaker: god
text: Any male among the priests may eat it; it is most holy.

speaker: god
text: But no sin offering may be eaten if its blood has been brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place; it must be burned.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Now this is the law of the guilt offering, which is most holy:

speaker: god
text: The guilt offering must be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and the priest shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.

speaker: god
text: And all the fat from it shall be offered: the fat tail, the fat that covers the entrails,

speaker: god
text: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.

speaker: god
text: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made by fire to the LORD; it is a guilt offering.

speaker: god
text: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

speaker: god
text: The guilt offering is like the sin offering; the same law applies to both. It belongs to the priest who makes atonement with it.

speaker: god
text: As for the priest who presents a burnt offering for anyone, the hide of that offering belongs to him.

speaker: god
text: Likewise, every grain offering that is baked in an oven or cooked in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who presents it,

speaker: god
text: and every grain offering, whether dry or mixed with oil, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

speaker: god
text: Now this is the law of the peace offering that one may present to the LORD:

speaker: god
text: If he offers it in thanksgiving, then along with the sacrifice of thanksgiving he shall offer unleavened cakes mixed with olive oil, unleavened wafers coated with oil, and well-kneaded cakes of fine flour mixed with oil.

speaker: god
text: Along with his peace offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of leavened bread.

speaker: god
text: From the cakes he must present one portion of each offering as a contribution to the LORD. It belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offering.

speaker: god
text: The meat of the sacrifice of his peace offering of thanksgiving must be eaten on the day he offers it; none of it may be left until morning.

speaker: god
text: If, however, the sacrifice he offers is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice, but the remainder may be eaten on the next day.

speaker: god
text: But any meat of the sacrifice remaining until the third day must be burned up.

speaker: god
text: If any of the meat from his peace offering is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who presented it; it shall be an abomination, and the one who eats of it shall bear his iniquity.

speaker: god
text: Meat that touches anything unclean must not be eaten; it is to be burned up. As for any other meat, anyone who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

speaker: god
text: But if anyone who is unclean eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.

speaker: god
text: If one touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any unclean, detestable thing, and then eats any of the meat of the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat.

speaker: god
text: The fat of an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

speaker: moses
text: The fat of an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

speaker: god
text: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which an offering made by fire may be presented to the LORD, the one who eats it must be cut off from his people.

speaker: moses
text: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which an offering made by fire may be presented to the LORD, the one who eats it must be cut off from his people.

speaker: god
text: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings.

speaker: moses
text: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings.

speaker: god
text: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.’

speaker: moses
text: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice to the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: Anyone who presents a peace offering to the LORD must bring it as his sacrifice to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: With his own hands he is to bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD; he shall bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: With his own hands he is to bring the offerings made by fire to the LORD; he shall bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast as a wave offering before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

speaker: moses
text: The priest is to burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

speaker: god
text: And you are to give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from your peace offering.

speaker: moses
text: And you are to give the right thigh to the priest as a contribution from your peace offering.

speaker: god
text: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion.

speaker: moses
text: The son of Aaron who presents the blood and fat of the peace offering shall have the right thigh as a portion.

speaker: god
text: I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a permanent portion from the sons of Israel.’

speaker: moses
text: I have taken from the sons of Israel the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as a permanent portion from the sons of Israel.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread,

speaker: god
text: and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.

speaker: moses
text: Boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’

speaker: moses
text: Aaron and his sons are to eat it.

speaker: moses
text: Then you must burn up the remainder of the meat and bread.

speaker: moses
text: You must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.

speaker: moses
text: What has been done today has been commanded by the LORD in order to make atonement on your behalf.

speaker: moses
text: You must remain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and keep the LORD’s charge so that you will not die, for this is what I have been commanded.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Take for yourself a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering, both without blemish, and present them before the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: Then speak to the Israelites and say, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without blemish—for a burnt offering,

speaker: aaron
name: Aaron
text: Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb—both a year old and without blemish—for a burnt offering,

speaker: moses
text: an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.’

speaker: aaron
text: an ox and a ram for a peace offering to sacrifice before the LORD, and a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.

speaker: moses
text: This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you.

speaker: moses
text: Approach the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and for the people. And sacrifice the people’s offering to make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: This is what the LORD meant when He said: ‘To those who come near Me I will show My holiness, and in the sight of all the people I will reveal My glory.’

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: To those who come near Me I will show My holiness, and in the sight of all the people I will reveal My glory.

speaker: moses

text: When someone has a swelling or rash or bright spot on his skin that could become an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to examine the infection on his skin, and if the hair in the infection has turned white and the sore appears to be deeper than the skin, it is a skin disease. After the priest examines him, he must pronounce him unclean.

speaker: god
text: If, however, the spot on his skin is white and does not appear to be deeper than the skin, and the hair in it has not turned white, the priest shall isolate the infected person for seven days.

speaker: god
text: On the seventh day the priest is to reexamine him, and if he sees that the infection is unchanged and has not spread on the skin, the priest must isolate him for another seven days.

speaker: god
text: The priest will examine him again on the seventh day, and if the sore has faded and has not spread on the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is a rash. The person must wash his clothes and be clean.

speaker: god
text: But if the rash spreads further on his skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he must present himself again to the priest.

speaker: god
text: The priest will reexamine him, and if the rash has spread on the skin, the priest must pronounce him unclean; he has a skin disease.

text: When anyone develops a skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

text: The priest will examine him, and if there is a white swelling on the skin that has turned the hair white, and there is raw flesh in the swelling,

speaker: god

text: But if the skin disease breaks out all over his skin so that it covers all the skin of the infected person from head to foot, as far as the priest can see,

speaker: god
text: the priest shall examine him, and if the disease has covered his entire body, he is to pronounce the infected person clean. Since it has all turned white, he is clean.

speaker: god
text: But whenever raw flesh appears on someone, he will be unclean.

speaker: god
text: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he must pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; it is a skin disease.

speaker: god
text: But if the raw flesh changes and turns white, he must go to the priest.

speaker: god
text: The priest will reexamine him, and if the infection has turned white, the priest is to pronounce the infected person clean; then he is clean.

speaker: god
text: When a boil appears on someone’s skin and it heals,

speaker: god
text: But if the spot remains unchanged and does not spread, it is only the scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

text: But if the spot is unchanged and has not spread on the skin but has faded, it is a swelling from the burn, and the priest is to pronounce him clean; for it is only the scar from the burn.
